issue:
Missing OVERLOAD_OVERLAP error code causes internal error

I'm getting an internal error when working with overloaded functions in mypy. When I have overlapping overloads, instead of getting a proper warning, mypy crashes with an AttributeError.

Here's a simple example that reproduces the issue:

```python
from typing import overload

@overload
def func(x: int) -> int: ...

@overload
def func(x: int) -> str: ...  # overlaps with the first overload

def func(x: int) -> int:
    return x
```

When I run mypy on this code, instead of getting a warning about overlapping overloads, I get:

```
main:3: error: INTERNAL ERROR -- Please try using mypy master on GitHub:
https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/stable/common_issues.html#using-a-development-mypy-build
Please report a bug at https://github.com/python/mypy/issues
AttributeError: module 'mypy.errorcodes' has no attribute 'OVERLOAD_OVERLAP'
```

It looks like mypy is trying to use an error code that doesn't exist. This happens when I have multiple overloads that overlap in unsafe ways.

I'm using mypy version 1.16.0+dev. This issue doesn't appear in older versions of mypy, so it seems like a recent regression.
